args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18. Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), which was unhealthy with an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; v2.3.0 (and v2.2.9 before it) were healthy.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** — the most recent release that was healthy in production — across all regions. The rollback was verified as rolled out.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident**: Created incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the rollback action, which paged the on-call engineer.

4. **Verified recovery**: Post-rollback status shows checkout-api on v2.3.0 in all regions, healthy, with error rate back down to 0.2%.
